question_content: Which command deploys a container image as a Cloud Run service?
question_cn_content: 下列哪一個指令可以把容器映像檔部署成 Cloud Run 服務？
detail_explain: gcloud run deploy deploys a container image to Cloud Run and creates a new revision.
expert_comment: 此題要點：Cloud Run 的指令都在 gcloud run 底下；每次部署都會產生新的修訂版（revision）。

question_content: You want a Cloud Run service to be called automatically whenever a new file is uploaded to a Cloud Storage bucket. Which service should route the event?
question_cn_content: 希望每次有新檔案上傳到 Cloud Storage 值區時，自動呼叫某個 Cloud Run 服務。應該用哪個服務轉送這個事件？
detail_explain: Eventarc routes events from Google Cloud sources such as Cloud Storage to targets such as Cloud Run.
expert_comment: 此題要點：「事件發生就觸發」找 Eventarc；「固定時間觸發」才是 Cloud Scheduler。

question_content: Which Cloud Run setting controls the maximum number of requests that a single container instance can handle at the same time?
question_cn_content: Cloud Run 的哪一個設定，決定單一容器執行個體同時最多處理幾個請求？
detail_explain: Concurrency sets the maximum number of simultaneous requests per container instance. When it is reached, Cloud Run starts more instances.
expert_comment: 此題要點：concurrency 是「每個執行個體」同時處理幾個請求；max instances 是「最多幾個執行個體」。
